manifest.description: Rewrite UI.getCurrent() / VaadinSession.getCurrent() (and similar accessor-style static lookups) to an injected Provider<UI> / Provider<VaadinSession> expression. v1 ships caller rewrites only (note-7d4f0001).
when_to_use: remove Vaadin static-context escape hatches in DI-managed view code
anti_patterns: do not use without staging Provider<UI> / Provider<VaadinSession> @Inject fields on the caller's enclosing class — operator must add the injection first
do not use in method-reference contexts (`UI::getCurrent` passed as Supplier) — those need different rewriting

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-replace-vaadin-static-lookup. Charter: Replace `UI.getCurrent()` / `VaadinSession.getCurrent()` with injected provider expressions.

Protocol:

1. Ground.
2. Verify the provider field is staged.
3. Plan in drop-accessor mode:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="replace_java_static_reference",
                      deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source}}",
                      impl_name="{{impl_name}}",
                      new_text="{{new_text}}",
                      item_names=["getCurrent"],
                      delegate_field="{{impl_name}}.getCurrent")
4. Apply and compile-verify.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source}} {{impl_name}} {{new_text}}
